namespace_note: Proposed namespace; no claim that the endpoint is published. Context is inline-pinned; no remote context fetch.
notice: Reviewer evidence, not approval. Every record has is_approval false; missing information is unknown, never fail. A Decision records a human act and is never made by machine.

types.definition: An immutable, application-bound statement of the payloads sent, by whom, to whom, and for what purpose; its receipt is delivery evidence only.
A check of one exact package against identified information expectations, kept separate from the intake act that may accept it.
An applicant's declaration of limited element changes between a pinned parent and an intended child revision, shown apart from verified differences.
A human building official's recorded disposition, with authority, attestation, validity, conditions and evidence; the core Decision type.
A separately identified, anchored case note referenced by a Decision's conditions; it points at a basis and never restates a requirement.

iri_or_unknown_terms.note: Values are an IRI or the literal unknown. They are deliberately not @id-coerced so unknown is never turned into an invented IRI.

context_fixes.finding: Design CHECKS.md: Decision conditions were reference strings but the inline context gave only an @set container, so they expanded as literals.
context_fixes.fix: conditions is coerced with @type @id; regression test verification/tests/test_lifecycle_records_jsonld.py.

context_fixes.finding: child_views, condition_records and verified_scope had no @set container; one-member arrays compacted to bare objects and failed the round-trip test.
context_fixes.fix: @container @set added; test asserts every array-valued key is a @set term.

context_fixes.finding: id/type aliases next to @id/@type made compaction rewrite keys, so records did not round-trip.

sources: Term shapes follow W3C PROV-O and Dublin Core Terms by reference only (attribution, no affiliation). No specification text is reproduced.
